la-gloria-cubana-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Founded in 1885, La Gloria Cubana is one of the quieter Habanos brands, with a loyal following made up largely of seasoned smokers. Filler and binder are grown in the Vuelta Abajo, and every size is long filler and rolled entirely by hand. Habanos classes the blend as medium, with taste and aroma kept in balance.

la-gloria-cubana-cuba--serie-medaille-d-.description: The Médaille d'Or series is La Gloria Cubana's line of slim cigars in an elegant presentation, with Vuelta Abajo filler and binder. The No. 4 is a 32-ring panetela about six inches long; it opens on coffee, nuts and honey, moves through cedar and caramel sweetness, and closes on roasted hazelnut and old oak.

thirds.notes: Subtle coffee and nuts gain honey and light spice; another smoke shows tart, floral touches as an early dryness turns creamy.
Cedar leads, with green walnut and a returning caramel sweetness; puffing hard brings some harshness.
The flavours grow richer: roasted hazelnut, old oak, cedar and honey, sweet and herbal without bitterness.
